notes: Music: a track for the menu and lobby, another for matches, and a short fanfare when a match is won or lost. Set its volume with the new Music slider in Settings.
Combat sounds: a tick when your hit lands and a ping for a kill, a crack when your shield breaks and a hum as it recharges, a heartbeat when you're in danger, plus jump and respawn sounds.
The announcer is easier to hear over the action, the game goes muffled behind the pause menu, and on computers it mutes while in the background (you can turn that off in Settings).
"More details" in the update notice opens the full changelog in your browser.
